claim.quote: The background model developed for the detector presently installed in Canfranc points to levels from 1 to 10 counts keV-1 kg-1 d-1 in the region of interest, making TREX-DM competitive in the search for low-mass WIMPs.

name: Background assessment for the TREX Dark Matter experiment
notes: Date: first arXiv submission (v1, 11 Dec 2018); the abstract quoted is that of the latest arXiv version (v2, last revised 22 Sep 2019).

summary.plain: A full study of the radioactive backgrounds expected in TREX-DM, built from material assays and simulation, predicting levels low enough to be competitive for light WIMPs.
summary.technical: Geant4 model using measured gamma, muon and neutron fluxes at the LSC and assayed component activities; the abstract quotes 1 to 10 counts keV-1 kg-1 d-1 with a roadmap to 0.1 counts keV-1 kg-1 d-1. A model prediction, not a measurement. Published as Eur. Phys. J. C 79 (2019) 782.

title: Background assessment for the TREX Dark Matter experiment
why_it_matters: The abstract says a roadmap to decrease the background further is underway.
